_about: Approved Pixhawk configuration for the Airsent quad (ArduCopter 4.6, Pixhawk 6C, T-Motor ALPHA 40A, Tattu 6S 10000 mAh, Holybro PM07). The launch sequencer HOLDS at the vehicle handover if any live value differs. Change a value here only on purpose, commit it, and redeploy to the Jetson.

ARMING_SKIPCHK.why: Newer ArduPilot: 0 = no arming checks skipped

DISARM_DELAY.why: The sequencer arms at T-10; ArduPilot must not auto-disarm before T-0

RNGFND1_POS_X.why: H-Flow LiDAR 7.375 in forward of the centre of gravity

RNGFND1_POS_Y.why: H-Flow LiDAR on the centre line

RNGFND1_POS_Z.why: H-Flow LiDAR 2.79 in below the centre of gravity

FLOW_POS_X.why: H-Flow optical flow 7.375 in forward of the centre of gravity

FLOW_POS_Y.why: H-Flow optical flow on the centre line

FLOW_POS_Z.why: H-Flow optical flow 2.79 in below the centre of gravity

FLOW_ORIENT_YAW.why: H-Flow arrow points to the nose

GPS1_POS_X.why: H-RTK antenna 2.7 in behind the centre of gravity

GPS_POS1_X.why: H-RTK antenna 2.7 in behind the centre of gravity

GPS1_POS_Y.why: H-RTK antenna 2.55 in left of the centre line

GPS_POS1_Y.why: H-RTK antenna 2.55 in left of the centre line

GPS1_POS_Z.why: H-RTK antenna 8.375 in above the centre of gravity (mast)
